title: Sweet Delicacies
description: a mod that makes you have more opinions of food
body:
This mod adds various new foods for minecraft for an more variated diet

Current foods 1.0
-boiled eggs
 crafted by cooking a egg
-apple pie
 crafted with 1 apple , 1 sugar , 1 egg and 1 sweat berrie
-coco stew
 crafted with 2 coco beans , 1 bowl and 1 sugar
-copper potato
 crafted with 8 copper ingots and 1 baked potato, can be used to make haste potions
-golden beetrot
 crafted with 4 gold nuggets , 4 gold bars and 1 beetrot , gives haste,speed and resistence when ate
-resin cookies
 crafted with 4 resins and 1 cookie and can be used to make saturation   potions
